scope: Exact current PracticeVisual function extracted and transpiled without modifying it; React static rendering of actual public bank case and separate proposed clone. Loopback-only fixture with restrictive CSP. Five widths each; no production daily opening/answer/progress/reset/admin/DB action. Not an actual public-date screenshot.

rows.scenario:
You make 20 hypothetical transactions, each with $500 notional and a 0.1% transaction fee. For this worksheet their combined gross price gains are $8 and no other costs occur. Treat a transaction as one buy or one sell, so a round trip counts twice. Evaluate total turnover and fees before calling the activity profitable.

Continue the worksheet with two alternatives. In one branch, gross gains remain $8 while transaction count doubles to 40 at $500 each. In another, transaction count remains 20 but gross gains rise to $12. Keep the 0.1% fee and exclude other costs. Compare turnover, average fee per transaction and net outcome before interpreting the number of trades as evidence of skill.
